title: Big climb day, 3 loops on tired legs
coachNotes: Moved from Saturday at athlete request. This is now the harder arrangement, not the easier one: 1100m of descent lands on day-2 legs, which is a closer rehearsal of the race's final 1250m drop but also the highest ITB exposure since 2 Aug. That is the deliberate trade. Climbs at 89-93% LTHR (160-167), strong hike or run. Descents short strides, high cadence, no braking, poles if you have them. MORNING GATE (Saturday 15 was converted to full rest, RHR 54): go full 3 loops only if RHR is 52 or below AND HRV is 55 or above. If RHR is 53 or higher, or HRV is under 55, run 2 loops and stop (load ~120), do not negotiate loop 3 on the hill. If RHR is 55 or higher, drop to a single loop at Z2 with a walked descent (load ~55). Hard abort rule regardless of the gate: stop after loop 2 if there is any lateral knee signal, any at all, and log it. Start by 06:30 for the heat; if it is hot, judge climbs by effort and let HR run above range. Monday 17 is easy 30 and Tuesday 18 is a full travel day, so you have two clear days to absorb this.
